column1: # One row per physical device. `id` is the device's own stable name (as in zigbee2mqtt), never the room: sensors move.
# `room` must be an id from rooms.tsv and is also readable as the cells <id>.room and <id>.room_name.
# `kind` decides which cells the device exposes (see engine/src/core/kinds.ts).
# source: z2m:<friendly name> (zigbee2mqtt) or mqtt:<topic> (generic JSON topic, e.g. the GPIO service).
